name: logging
description: Structured, leve-tagged, trace-id-correlated logging for every AIOS module. Writes JSON lines under aios/.cache/logs/ with rotation. Logs are the human-audit surface for Engineering Law 13 (Complete Traceability) and Constitution Principle 14 (Trace Everything).

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: trace | debug | info | warn | error | fatal

inputs.name: trace_id
inputs.description: AIOS-REQ-NNNNNN correlating this log to a request.

inputs.name: fields
inputs.description: Structured key/value fields appended to the JSON line.

outputs.name: sequence
outputs.description: Monotonic sequence number assigned to this line for strict ordering.

side_effects: Appends one JSON line to aios/.cache/logs/aios-<date>.jsonl
Rotates when the active log exceeds the configured max_size_mb

error_codes.message: Log file could not be written (disk full or path locked).
error_codes.recovery: Fall back to stderr; continue operation; surface a degraded-capability warning (Law 9).

examples: log(info, AIOS-MODULE-000009, 'generated module foo', trace_id=AIOS-REQ-000123, fields={files:3}) -> sequence=9842
